biggest_catch: Offer expires September 30, 2026 — about 7 days from verification (2026-09-23). After opening, you have only 60 calendar days to complete the qualifying activities, and the $300 is not paid until the 60-day qualifying period ends.
catches: Offer open window ends September 30, 2026 — open the account before then; promotional window 04/01/2026–09/30/2026.
Promo code 300BONUS must be used at account opening; excludes SouthState at Work product type.
Within 60 calendar days: make 15+ posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments AND have $250+ qualifying direct deposits OR $25+ preauthorized automatic drafts.
Qualifying direct deposits exclude internal transfers, mobile deposits, debit card deposits, person-to-person transfers, instant payments, and branch/ATM deposits.
Account must stay open with no change to product type (SouthState/Choice/Gold Checking) until payout.
New customers only: cannot currently own (or jointly own), or have owned in the past 12 months, a SouthState personal checking account; must not have previously received a personal checking bonus.
SouthState Checking has a $5 monthly maintenance charge unless enrolled in eStatements; $25 minimum opening deposit at a branch, $0 minimum to open online.
The $300 bonus will be reported to the appropriate taxing authorities, as required by law.
Not available to employees of SouthState Bank, N.A. or its subsidiaries; residency restrictions may apply.

steps: Open a new SouthState personal checking account between 04/01/2026 and 09/30/2026 (online $0 minimum; $25 minimum in branch), entering promo code 300BONUS.
Within 60 calendar days of opening, make at least 15 posted and cleared debit card purchases/payments.
Within the same 60 days, also receive $250+ in qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security) OR set up $25+ in preauthorized automatic drafts.
Keep the account open without changing product type until payout; enroll in eStatements to avoid the $5 monthly maintenance charge.
The $300 bonus posts within 2 business days of the end of the 60-day qualifying period.
